name: collections
description: Cash collected in a date range by charge type, for one property or the whole portfolio (built-in ReceiptsBreakdown report). Use for 'how much did <property> collect in <month>'.
use: Cash collected over a period, by charge type
answer_hint: Cash receipts applied by charge type (rent, fees, deposits, prepaid, unallocated). Rent = Rent Charge incl. prepaid rent; rental assistance, use & occupancy, HOA etc. are separate lines. Portfolio total can differ from payments_received (that one totals raw payments).

property.description: Property name/nickname/ID, comma-separated for several; empty = all

headline: Collected {sum$:Collected} from {start} to {end} (rent {sumif$:Collected|Description|Rent Charge}).
